title: Running Commentary on Torah 39 — V'nasati Eisev b'Sadcha
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 39 — ונתתי עשב בשדך
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text, in three layers: beginner = readable English prose with bracketed translations of every Hebrew/Aramaic term; intermediate = compact bilingual summary with citations; scholarly = terse Hebrew citation list.
